intro.text: A sea under a royal government, whose tax collectors and inspectors oversee the movement of ships and cargo and whose navy pursues criminals such as deadrunners.
A pentagonal sea of verdant spores, fed by the Verdant Lunagree and also called the Verdant Sea. It borders the Crimson Sea, the Rose Sea and three other seas.

description.text: Its law holds the offender and every accomplice guilty of murder if anyone dies while a dangerous crime is being carried out.
The Verdant King rules it, at least in part.
